problems: The brief owns no Cliopatria row: the thirteen dossiers are the states Cliopatria lacks that the eu-22 scope and the sibling reports (eu-22-a, eu-22-e, eu-20-k) name; all are new_state with cliopatria_names [] and every keyframe new (verdict adjust).
Pages opened: 23 distinct Wikipedia pages, 27 source entries across the dossiers; History_of_Saarland failed (url_not_found); every other fetch succeeded.
Living states (transnistria, vatican-city, san-marino) end in 2026; the other eu-22 parts end living states in 2024 (Cliopatria's last year). The orchestrator should normalise.

republika-srpska ends 14 December 1995 and croatian-republic-of-herzeg-bosnia ends March 1994 to match eu-22-e's bosnia-and-herzegovina events (gain from republika-srpska 1995-12; gain from herzeg-bosnia 1994-03); the Herzeg-Bosnia page puts formal abolition at August 1996.

allied-occupied-germany records the occupation events with roles reversed (counterpart = occupier) and ends in 1949; the Western occupation of the Federal Republic to 5 May 1955 belongs to federal-republic-of-germany. Its counterparts republic-of-poland (Cliopatria row from 1953), united-kingdom, united-states-of-america, french-fourth-republic and union-of-soviet-socialist-republics were checked against polities.csv or polities/.
west-berlin starts in 1945 to match eu-22-a's occupation_start with counterpart west-berlin; East Berlin cannot be separated from Natural Earth's Berlin at the grid's resolution.
transnistria may overlap Cliopatria's russian-occupied-territories row (another eu-22 part's); Abkhazia and South Ossetia are eu-19's.

Shapes of the de facto states (Krajina, Trieste Zone B, Western Bosnia, DPR, LPR, the Baden-Wuerttemberg split) are circles round towns the pages name, tuned to the page's figure where one exists (infobox areas for Herzeg-Bosnia, Krajina, Western Bosnia; the '55% of Donetsk Oblast by June 2022' figure); the keyframe notes say so.
Natural Earth spells the Bosnian entity 'Repuplika Srpska' and the oblasts "Donets'k" and "Luhans'k"; the dossiers use those spellings.
wikidata is null in all thirteen dossiers (wikidata.org unreachable).
